answer.question: What is healthcare SEO?
answer.text: Healthcare SEO is the process of improving a medical provider's online visibility so patients can find it when searching for care or health information. It includes local SEO, expert-reviewed medical content, service and condition pages, patient reviews, and a fast, accessible website.

why.title: Why does healthcare SEO need extra care?

cards.title: Google's highest quality standards
cards.text: Health content can affect people's wellbeing, so Google expects clear expertise, accuracy and trust.

cards.title: Local search drives bookings
cards.text: Most patients search for providers near them, which makes Google Maps visibility essential.

cards.title: Patient privacy
cards.text: Tracking and forms must be set up carefully to protect patient information.

cards.title: Accessibility matters
cards.text: Patients of all ages and abilities need to be able to use your website easily.

cards.title: Service & condition pages
cards.text: Clear pages for each treatment and condition you handle.

cards.title: Medically reviewed content
cards.text: Written in plain language and reviewed by your clinicians.

cards.title: Provider profiles
cards.text: Credentials, specialties and experience for each practitioner.

cards.title: Technical & accessibility SEO
cards.text: Speed, mobile experience, accessibility and MedicalClinic / Physician schema.

cards.title: Privacy-conscious tracking
cards.text: Analytics set up without sending sensitive patient data to third parties.

ai.title: How do AI tools answer health questions?
ai.text: Patients ask AI tools questions like "What does a physiotherapist do for back pain?" or "Best dentist near me open Saturday." AI tools prefer trustworthy, clearly written information from credible sources.
prompts: What does a physiotherapist do for back pain?
Best dentist near me open Saturday.
ai.list_title: How we improve your AI visibility:
items: Clear, accurate answers reviewed by qualified professionals
Visible author and reviewer credentials on every article
Consistent practice information across Google, Healthgrades, Zocdoc and directories
Up-to-date details like hours, services and insurance accepted

callout.title: Privacy note
callout.text: We set up analytics and tracking so protected health information isn't shared with advertising or analytics tools. Your organization remains responsible for its own HIPAA (or local privacy law) compliance.

items.question: How long does healthcare SEO take?
items.answer: Local SEO improvements often show results within 1–3 months. Competitive specialties and regions can take 6–12 months.

items.question: Who should write medical content?
items.answer: Content can be written by skilled writers, but it should always be reviewed and approved by a qualified healthcare professional, with their name and credentials shown.

items.question: Do you work with dental and specialty practices?
items.answer: Yes. We work with dental, physiotherapy, chiropractic, aesthetics, mental health and other healthcare providers.

items.question: Is patient data safe with SEO tracking?
items.answer: It can be, when tracking is set up correctly. We avoid sending sensitive patient information to analytics or advertising tools.

items.question: Should each treatment have its own page?
items.answer: Yes. Separate pages for each service help patients find exactly what they need and help each page rank for its own searches.
